newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds end mixed, seen underperfoming.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds end mixed, seen underperfoming.

text.p: Finnish bonds closed a lacklustre Monday session mixed, with the longest benchmark bond lifted by buoyant overseas debt markets.
Dealers said they were confident the recent international debt market rally would continue provided that German and U.S. data this week do not upset the bullish market tone.
But they saw little scope for the 10-year yield premium over Germany to narrow in the near term.
"I rather expect the gap to widen before year-end," one said.
Operators said there was scant buying interest in the Finnish market and it was not expected to pick-up before year-end.
The U.S. National Association of Purchasing Managers index for Novemeber and October and construction spending data are due at 1700/1500 GMT.
